title: Mcp Design Viewer Refetches Full Show Design From Server
description: Cursor truncates structuredContent; add callServerTool(show_design) refetch with delayed retries and merge richer payloads by score like kit viewer.
summary: McpDesignViewer now mirrors McpKitViewer: ontoolinput/partial/onhostcontextchanged trigger refetch; staggered callServerTool({ name: "show_design", arguments: {} }) to recover full JSON when host only surfaces truncated structuredContent (one piece/one diagram node). mergeDiagramPayload keeps highest scoreMcpDiagramPayload; host context scans all tool-result keys and picks best. Selection resets when payload score changes. Rebuilt dist/mcp-app.html.
